stations.text: Turns a message into a depot request.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Odd replies crash or slip by

stations.title: Depot system
stations.text: Acts on every change it gets.

captions: Summaries are whole now. Next, customers ask Kes to change a delivery.
Kes replies, but the change endpoint crashes before the depot hears of it.
You crash it on purpose, fix it and write the test, in three tasks.
Now the request reaches the depot instead of crashing on the way.
Same message, no 500. And a test keeps it that way.
